commercialPriorities.notes: Urban London meetings hotel at 22 Portman Square. 243 rooms and suites. Ballroom reception 700 is agreed by the website and the July 2025 brochure grid. Theatre 550 prose vs 500 grid, and cabaret 250 prose vs 256 grid, stay unresolved. Sakura prose says 18 seats; the grid says boardroom 14. No published total meeting-room count. ExCeL, Olympia, sports, and touring productions are in scope only with overnight or referral evidence. Association contacts are not planners.

Buyout copy says three event spaces plus restaurant, lounge, bar and terrace, pilates and wellness, and all 243 bedrooms. The capacity grid names more subdivisions. Those counts are not collapsed.
